segments.text: The exponential distribution measures the waiting time until the next event.
segments.caption: The exponential distribution measures the waiting time until the next event.

segments.text: The events happen at random, at a steady average rate.

segments.text: Short waits are the most common, and long waits get rarer and rarer.

segments.text: Four an hour means one every fifteen minutes, on average.

segments.text: But real gaps vary: six minutes, then twenty-two, then three, then thirty-one.

segments.text: So remember: the exponential distribution measures the waiting time until the next event, when events happen at random at a steady rate.
